Original Text: Artificial Intelligence is transforming the world. It is used in healthcare, education and business. Machine learning helps computers learn from data.
Summary: artificial intelligence is transforming the world . it is used in healthcare, education and business .
French Translation: L'intelligence artificielle transforme le monde. Elle est utilisée dans les soins de santé, l'éducation et les affaires.
Spanish Translation: La Inteligencia Artificial está transformando el mundo. Se utiliza en salud, educación y negocios. El aprendizaje automático ayuda a las computadoras a aprender de los datos.

Original Text: Hugging Face provides pretrained models and tools for Natural Language Processing. It supports tasks such as translation, summarization and question answering.
Summary: Hugging Face provides pretrained models and tools for natural language processing . it supports tasks such as translation, summarization and question answering .
French Translation: Hugging Face fournit des modèles et des outils préformés pour le traitement du langage naturel. Il prend en charge des tâches telles que la traduction, la synthèse et la réponse aux questions.
Spanish Translation: Hugging Face proporciona modelos y herramientas pre-entrenados para el Procesamiento del Lenguaje Natural. Soporta tareas como traducción, resumen y respuesta de preguntas.
